issue.title: External SASE checkout fails plan validation because its configured plans sidecar is absent
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-df.4.1.1 note #3 and bob-cli-df.4.1.3 note #2; repeated in bob-cli-df.4.1.4 note #1. Landing independently ran sase validate in the clean external sase checkout at dcb7d2a6e7: init repo --check passed, but plan links validate failed invalid-root for that checkout/sase/repos/plans. No source edits were present. Resolve the mismatch between external repo preparation and validation context: provision the correct isolated sidecars or validate against an explicitly resolved read context. Do not silence validation or read/write another workspace directly. The earlier proposed command sase validate plan-links is shorthand for the plan-links stage, not valid CLI syntax; use sase validate or sase plan links validate. Duplicate searches and the last-week task sweep found only unrelated closed bob-cli-y (legacy prompts in plans); active bob-cli epics and the causal Footprint epic do not own external checkout provisioning. Large because choosing the correct read/materialization ownership boundary requires investigation before implementation.

task_type_fields.impact: Required just check stops on environment validation in clean external SASE checkouts, preventing scoped tests from establishing feature acceptance.
task_type_fields.location: sase repo external checkout preparation; src/sase/main/validate_handler.py plan links validate stage and SDD root resolution
task_type_fields.repro: From a numbered bob-cli workspace, use sase repo open sase, enter the returned checkout, then run sase validate. plan links validate reports invalid-root for missing sase/repos/plans even though init repo --check passes.

issue.creation_reason: Recovery epic phases repeatedly lost required check coverage to this independent external-checkout environment failure. Landing reproduced it on clean SASE dcb7d2a6e7 after opening through sase repo, so it needs its own fix outside the recovery epic.
